description.zh:
数据中心，需要与[CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~)中的数据中心一致。
> 当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）。
description.en:
The data center. This must be the same data center that you specified when you called [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~).

> Valid values: \`cn-shanghai\` (Shanghai) and \`ap-southeast-1\` (Singapore).

description.zh: 移除被禁言的用户列表。多个用半角逗号（,）隔开，最多不超过30个。
description.en: The list of users to unmute. You can specify up to 30 users. Separate multiple user IDs with commas (,).

descriptions.zh:
调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[CreateLiveMessageGroup](~~2848163~~)创建互动消息群组。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You must call [CreateLiveMessageGroup](~~2848163~~) to create an interactive message group before you call this operation.

## QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user is 10 calls per second. Exceeding this limit triggers API throttling, which may affect your business. We recommend that you call this operation at a reasonable rate.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live remove-live-message-group-band --app-id demo --group-id grouptest --unbanned-users uid1 --data-center cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live RemoveLiveMessageGroupBand --region cn-hangzhou --DataCenter 'cn-shanghai' --AppId demo --UnbannedUsers uid1 --GroupId grouptest
